subject: converting color scale code to the new version of ggplot2

messages.author: 0b60af4016d9ffed
messages.subject: converting color scale code to the new version of ggplot2
parts:
Following some examples I found on the web, I was able to successfully create some heat maps using ggplot2. Details are here. But, before I move on to explore ggmap there's one issue that I was banging my head against that I'd love to see an answer to, just for closure.

The example I was following relied on the previous version of ggplot2 found in R v2.12.2. I couldn't get it to run in the new version of ggplot2 found in 2.15.1. Not for lack of trying, but too much about ggplot2 is a mystery to me right now.

Some code that works in 2.12.1 that contains the basics of what I'm doing is below. The problem is the structure returned by scale_colour_gradient2() and the like has changed. The previous version of that structure contained functions named train() and map() that I was using to create fill values for geom_tile(). But, those aren't available in the new version. I find very little about those two functions looking around, so I expect this was a non-standard technique, so the authors felt safe in abandoning it.

Anyways, does anyone know how to re-write the following so it will produce the same results in the latest version of ggplot2?

Ed


rm(list=ls())
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)

# data for a base map
PlotData.Base <- data.frame(expand.grid(lat=seq(1, 640), lon=seq(1,640)), fill=rep("#000000", 640*640))

# data for the heat map
DensityList <- kde2d(rnorm(100)*50+320, rnorm(100)*50+320, n = 320, lims = c(c(1,640), c(1,640)))
PlotData.Density <- expand.grid(lon = seq.int(1, 640, length.out = 320), lat = seq.int(1, 640,  length.out = 320))
PlotData.Density$density <- melt(DensityList$z)$value

# decide what colors to use for the heat map
DensityColorScale <- scale_colour_gradient2(low = 'white', mid = 'red4', high = 'red', midpoint = median(PlotData.Density$density))

# values for alpha to control opacity
PlotData.Density$density0to1  <- pmin(PlotData.Density$density / max(PlotData.Density$density), 0.4 )

#
# these are the problem lines
#
DensityColorScale$train(PlotData.Density$density, T)
PlotData.Density$densityColor <- DensityColorScale$map(PlotData.Density$density)

# plot base map
Plot <- ggplot()
Plot <- Plot + geom_tile(aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = fill), data = PlotData.Base)
# plot overlay map
Plot   <- Plot + geom_tile(aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = densityColor, alpha = density0to1), data = PlotData.Density)

print(Plot)
